items.project_definition: A synchronization gate ensuring all blocking infrastructure is verified before parallel feature development commences.
The core shared infrastructure layer providing essential serialization and I/O capabilities required by all subsequent features.
The primary functional objective a user must achieve within a specific feature set.
A unique alphanumeric token used to track specific implementation units within the project roadmap.
The lightweight data-interchange format used for persistent storage and machine-readable output.
The minimum set of functional capabilities required to provide basic value, specifically adding and completing entries.
The structural grouping of implementation units by user story to ensure independent testability.
The set of design and research documents that must be available before implementation begins.
The primary documentation file detailing usage instructions and storage behavior.
The initial phase involving package skeleton creation and tooling configuration.
The specific implementation unit responsible for providing user feedback when no entries are available for display.
The validation mechanisms, including unit, integration, and smoke verification, used to ensure system correctness.
The process of assigning a timestamp to the creation field during entry instantiation.
The operation that removes all entries marked as finished from the persistent store.
The operation that retrieves and displays all stored entries in either human-readable or structured formats.
A high-priority constraint indicating a hard dependency that blocks all subsequent feature work.
